create_conformer_shaw_model: create a conformer shaw wav2vec2 model from a Wav2Vec2Config with Shaw relative position attention
build_conformer_shaw_encoder_builder: build a ConformerShawEncoderBuilder with ShawRelativePositionSDPA and causal depthwise convolution
build_sdpa_shaw_relative: build a ShawRelativePositionSDPA attention module with configurable left and right relative position clipping
